title: Alert on burn rate across multiple windows
problem: Alerting on the raw error rate pages for short bursts that barely touch the budget and stays silent for slow leaks that exhaust it. Burn rate fixes the unit, but a single window still trades false pages against slow detection. The tool has to make that trade-off explicit.
context: Builds on the declared objective and budget. Alert rules are declared in the objective file.
impact: This is the output an on-call engineer acts on. A tool that pages wrongly gets muted, and a muted tool detects nothing.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Burn rate is computed as the observed bad-event ratio divided by the ratio the objective allows, for each configured window.
Each alert severity requires both a long and a short window to exceed its threshold. Thresholds and windows are declared data, not code.

Synthetic scenarios cover a short spike that must not page, a sustained burn that must page, and a slow leak that must raise a ticket-level alert. Before running each one, the learner writes down when they expect it to fire.
Every alert names which windows exceeded which thresholds and with what values.
An alert clears when the short window recovers, and the report says it cleared rather than simply disappearing.
Automated tests replay each scenario and assert the alert state over time. All pass at the submitted revision.
The learner compares the predicted and actual firing times, explains any gap, and names one situation where these rules still page wrongly or stay silent.

constraints: Standard library plus a test runner only.
No alert delivery. The tool reports a decision; it does not notify anyone.
Do not push to a remote or open a pull request as part of this task.

scope.description: Alert evaluation over the event stream and its explanation.

investigation_areas: How long a given burn rate takes to exhaust the whole budget, and what that implies for thresholds
Why a short window is needed alongside the long one
What evidence an on-call engineer needs in the alert text to decide in under a minute
testing_expectations: Run the project's own test suite. State the exact command in the design.
documentation_requirements: Record the alert thresholds and windows, the predictions and the actual firing times in the learner design.
